description: This file defines data structures, interfaces, and functions related to configuration changes in the Raft consensus protocol, including serialization, versioning, and parsing of configuration change commands.

classes.name: ConfChangeI
classes.description: Interface abstracting over ConfChangeV2 and legacy ConfChange for unified handling.

classes.name: ConfChange
classes.description: Represents a configuration change, with methods to convert to V2 and V1 formats.

classes.name: ConfChangeV2
classes.description: Represents a joint or simple configuration change with methods for version conversion, joint transition, and parsing.

classes.name: ConfChangeSingle
classes.description: Represents a single node change in the configuration (add, remove, update).

methods.name: MarshalConfChange
methods.description: Serializes a ConfChangeI into an EntryType and byte slice.

methods.name: AsV1
methods.description: Returns ConfChange and a boolean indicating if conversion to V1 is possible.

methods.name: AsV1
methods.description: Returns an empty ConfChange and false.

methods.name: EnterJoint
methods.description: Determines if the configuration change will use Joint Consensus and if it will auto-leave.

methods.name: LeaveJoint
methods.description: Checks if the ConfChangeV2 leaves a joint configuration.

methods.name: ConfChangesFromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a slice of ConfChangeSingle operations.

methods.name: ConfChangesToString
methods.description: Converts a slice of ConfChangeSingle operations into a string.
